verdict.rationale: mise's security docs say it automatically verifies Cosign/Minisign signatures, SLSA provenance and GitHub artifact attestations for aqua tools using its built-in implementation. The http backend also accepts per-platform sha256 checksums, and lockfiles with `mise install --locked` pin what gets installed. The verification claims are explicitly scoped to aqua tools, so coverage of the npm, pipx, github, asdf-plugin and other backends is not shown. missing for 10: evidence of verification across non-aqua backends, documentation of failure/enforcement behavior when verification fails, independent or hands-on corroboration.
